Advances and Challenges in KRAS Mutation Detection and Clinical Implications

Overview of the KRAS signaling pathway highlighting major downstream cascades (RAF–MEK–ERK, PI3K–AKT–mTOR, RalGDS) and the sites targeted by current inhibitors, including G12C covalent blockers (sotorasib, adagrasib) and upstream modulators (SHP2 and SOS1 inhibitors).
